title: Underived coefficient coherence for two pullback presentations
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring and all schemes below satisfy [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Take arrows v:V→T, u:U→T, φ:U→V, fV:YV→V, fU:YU→U, a:YU→YV, j:W→T, kV:ZV→W, kU:ZU→W, cV:ZV→YV, cU:ZU→YU and b:ZU→ZV. Assume φ ≫ v=u, a ≫ fV=fU ≫ φ, cV ≫ fV ≫ v=kV ≫ j, cU ≫ fU ≫ u=kU ≫ j, b ≫ kV=kU and cU ≫ a=b ≫ cV. For an étale Λ-module sheaf F on T [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], let FV=fV*v*F and FU=fU*u*F, using [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let d:a*FV→FU be the inverse (a,fV) composition comparison, the (fU,φ) comparison transported along a ≫ fV=fU ≫ φ, then fU* of the inverse (φ,v) comparison. Let eV:cV*FV→kV*j*F be cV* of the inverse (fV,v) comparison, the inverse (cV,fV ≫ v) comparison, transport along cV ≫ fV ≫ v=kV ≫ j, then the (kV,j) comparison. Define eU analogously. Let e:b*kV*j*F→kU*j*F be the inverse (b,kV) comparison. Then the (cU,a) forward comparison followed by cU*(d) and eU equals the (b,cV) forward comparison with named composite cU ≫ a, followed by b*(eV) and e. This is a purely underived equality of coefficient sheaf morphisms.

proof.text: Apply naturality and associativity of the inverse-image composition comparisons to (cU,a,fV), (cU,fU,φ), (fU,φ,v), (b,cV,fV), (cV,fV,v), and (b,kV,j). Move each mapped comparison past the next comparison. Cancel the paired forward and inverse comparisons. The arrow equalities identify the remaining single pullbacks and the equation cU ≫ a=b ≫ cV identifies their sources. Both uncancelled composites are the same normalized coefficient map to kU*j*F. Arrow-equality witnesses are irrelevant. Identity arrows and zero sheaves require no exceptions.
